markets.title: Japanese banks and insurers return to domestic bonds as yields surge
markets.raw_summary: Investors are closely watching for signs that the country’s institutions may be starting to repatriate capital after decades hunting for returns overseas

insight.what: 日本银行和保险公司因本国收益率飙升而回流国内债券，结束数十年海外逐利。
insight.why: 市场原本假设日本资金持续外流压低全球收益率，现在这个假设被打破，美债和海外资产面临抛压。
insight.chain: 日本国债收益率↑ → 海外资产相对吸引力↓ → 日机构回流本国 → 美债需求↓ → 美债收益率↑ → 全球高估值资产承压；日元套利交易平仓 → 日元升值
notes: 为什么日本机构回流？日本长期实行超低利率，机构被迫出海买美债、澳债等追求收益。现在本国国债收益率升到有吸引力水平，回流是理性选择。
套利交易是什么？借低息日元，换成美元买高息资产，赚利差。一旦日元升值或日本利率上升，这个交易就亏钱，引发平仓。
为什么美债收益率上升？日本是美债最大海外持有者之一，需求减少意味着价格下跌、收益率上升。
全球资产承压逻辑：美债收益率是全球无风险利率的锚，它上升意味着所有风险资产的折现率上升，估值缩水。
收益率上升债券价格下跌：债券价格和收益率呈反向变动。

insight_en.what: Japanese banks and insurers are returning to domestic bonds as yields at home surge, ending decades of seeking yield overseas.
insight_en.why: The market had assumed that continued outflows of Japanese capital would depress global yields. That assumption has now been overturned, leaving U.S. Treasuries and overseas assets facing selling pressure.
insight_en.chain: Japanese government bond yields↑ → Relative attractiveness of overseas assets↓ → Japanese institutions repatriate capital → Demand for U.S. Treasuries↓ → U.S. Treasury yields↑ → Global assets with high valuations come under pressure；Unwinding of yen carry trades → Yen appreciation
notes: Why are Japanese institutions returning to the domestic market? Japan has long maintained ultra-low interest rates, forcing institutions to seek yield overseas by buying U.S. Treasuries, Australian government bonds, and other assets. Now that domestic government bond yields have risen to attractive levels, returning to the domestic market is a rational choice.

What is a carry trade? Borrow yen at low interest rates, convert it into U.S. dollars, and buy higher-yielding assets to earn the interest rate differential. Once the yen appreciates or Japanese interest rates rise, the trade loses money, triggering an unwinding.
Why do U.S. Treasury yields rise? Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of U.S. Treasuries. Lower demand means lower prices and higher yields.
The logic behind pressure on global assets: U.S. Treasury yields anchor the global risk-free rate. A rise in these yields means higher discount rates for all risk assets and lower valuations.
Bond prices fall when yields rise: Bond prices and yields move inversely.

markets.title: Williams says Fed may not have to hike rates in 2027, at odds with traders
markets.raw_summary: New York Fed President John Williams sees one more rate hike in 2026 but no additional increase in 2027 as inflation pressures ease.

insight.what: 纽约联储主席威廉姆斯表示美联储可能不必在2027年加息，与市场交易员预期相左。
insight.why: 市场原本定价2027年还有加息，这番表态降低了长期利率路径预期，短端美债和利率敏感资产重新定价。
insight.chain: Williams放鸽 → 2027加息预期↓ → 长期利率路径下移 → 10Y美债收益率↓ → 成长股折现率↓ → 估值修复；美元走弱 → 新兴市场资本流入
notes: 为什么10年期国债？它反映市场对长期利率路径的预期，包括未来经济增长和通胀。
折现率是什么？把未来现金流折算成今天价值的利率。折现率下降，未来盈利的现值上升，成长股受益。
为什么与交易员预期相左很重要？联储官员表态是政策信号，市场会据此调整定价。分歧意味着未来波动可能加大。
美元走弱逻辑：利率预期下降，美元资产吸引力下降，资本流出美国。
鹰派 vs 鸽派：鹰派优先压通胀，倾向加息；鸽派优先保增长，对通胀容忍度高。Williams偏鸽。

insight_en.what: New York Fed President Williams said the Federal Reserve may not need to raise interest rates in 2027, contrary to market traders' expectations.
insight_en.why: The market had priced in further rate hikes in 2027. These remarks lowered expectations for the long-term interest rate path, prompting a repricing of short-dated U.S. Treasuries and interest-rate-sensitive assets.
insight_en.chain: Williams strikes a dovish tone → Expectations for 2027 rate hikes↓ → Long-term interest rate path shifts lower → 10Y U.S. Treasury yield↓ → Discount rates for growth stocks↓ → Valuation recovery；U.S. dollar weakens → Capital inflows into emerging markets
notes: Why the 10-year Treasury? It reflects market expectations for the long-term interest rate path, including future economic growth and inflation.

What is a discount rate? The interest rate used to discount future cash flows to their present value. When the discount rate falls, the present value of future earnings rises, benefiting growth stocks.

Why does a divergence from traders' expectations matter? Remarks by Fed officials are policy signals, and markets adjust their pricing accordingly. Divergence means volatility could increase in the future.
The logic behind a weaker U.S. dollar: Lower interest rate expectations reduce the attractiveness of U.S. dollar assets, leading to capital outflows from the United States.
Hawks vs. doves: Hawks prioritize curbing inflation and favor rate hikes; doves prioritize supporting growth and have a higher tolerance for inflation. Williams leans dovish.

policy.title: Iran: Political infighting deepens as economic woes mount during war
policy.raw_summary: Hardliners are stepping up pressure on Iran's government and calling for Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's removal. The oil minister resigned, but that's doing little to ease the pressure on President

insight.what: 伊朗经济困境加剧，强硬派施压政府，石油部长辞职，政治内斗加深。
insight.why: 市场原本定价伊朗石油出口稳定，内斗加剧可能影响出口政策，油价和地缘风险溢价面临重估。
insight.chain: 伊朗内斗加剧 → 石油政策不确定性↑ → 出口中断风险↑ → 原油供给预期↓ → 油价↑ → 全球通胀预期↑ → 央行加息压力↑
notes: 为什么伊朗重要？它是OPEC成员国，石油出口对全球供给有影响。政治不稳定可能导致出口中断。
地缘风险溢价是什么？市场为应对可能的供给中断而在油价中加入的额外溢价。
油价上涨如何影响通胀？能源是生产成本，油价上升推高整体物价，央行可能被迫加息。
为什么石油部长辞职重要？他负责出口政策，辞职意味着政策可能变化。
传导到资产：油价上升利好能源股，利空航空、运输等用油行业。

insight_en.what: Iran's economic difficulties are worsening, hardliners are pressuring the government, the oil minister has resigned, and political infighting is deepening.
insight_en.why: The market had priced in stable Iranian oil exports. Intensifying infighting could affect export policy, leaving oil prices and the geopolitical risk premium facing reassessment.
insight_en.chain: Infighting in Iran intensifies → Oil policy uncertainty↑ → Risk of export disruptions↑ → Expected crude oil supply↓ → Oil prices↑ → Global inflation expectations↑ → Pressure on central banks to raise rates↑
notes: Why does Iran matter? It is an OPEC member, and its oil exports affect global supply. Political instability could lead to export disruptions.
What is a geopolitical risk premium? An additional premium that markets build into oil prices to account for potential supply disruptions.
How do higher oil prices affect inflation? Energy is a production cost. Higher oil prices push up overall prices, and central banks may be forced to raise rates.
Why does the oil minister's resignation matter? He is responsible for export policy, and his resignation means policy could change.
Transmission to assets: Higher oil prices benefit energy stocks but hurt oil-consuming industries such as aviation and transportation.

tech.title: ASML Raises Full-Year Sales Outlook
tech.raw_summary: ASML upgraded the low end of its 2026 sales forecast as increasing artificial intelligence spending boosts demand for the Dutch company’s chip-making machines. The firm projected annual sales of betwe

insight.what: ASML上调全年销售预期，因AI支出增加提升对其芯片制造设备的需求。
insight.why: 市场原本担心芯片周期下行，ASML上调预期表明AI需求强劲，半导体设备板块和AI算力链重新定价。
insight.chain: AI支出↑ → 芯片需求↑ → 晶圆厂扩产 → ASML设备订单↑ → 营收预期↑ → 半导体设备股↑ → AI算力链估值↑
notes: ASML是什么？荷兰公司，生产光刻机，是芯片制造最核心设备，全球垄断。
为什么ASML重要？它是芯片供应链的上游，它的订单反映晶圆厂对未来芯片需求的预期。
AI支出如何传导？AI需要大量算力芯片，芯片需要晶圆厂制造，晶圆厂需要ASML设备。
半导体周期是什么？芯片行业有繁荣和萧条周期，ASML上调预期表明周期可能向上。
为什么股价上涨？营收预期上调意味着未来盈利增加，估值提升。

insight_en.what: ASML raised its full-year sales forecast as increased AI spending boosted demand for its chipmaking equipment.
insight_en.why: The market had been concerned about a downturn in the semiconductor cycle. ASML's upward revision to its forecast indicates strong AI demand, prompting a repricing of the semiconductor equipment sector and the AI compute value chain.
insight_en.chain: AI spending↑ → Chip demand↑ → Wafer fabs expand capacity → ASML equipment orders↑ → Revenue expectations↑ → Semiconductor equipment stocks↑ → AI compute value chain valuations↑
notes: What is ASML? It is a Dutch company that manufactures lithography machines, the most critical equipment in chipmaking, and holds a global monopoly.
Why does ASML matter? It operates upstream in the chip supply chain, and its orders reflect wafer fabs' expectations for future chip demand.
How does AI spending transmission work? AI requires large numbers of computing chips, chips need to be manufactured in wafer fabs, and wafer fabs need ASML equipment.
What is the semiconductor cycle? The chip industry goes through boom and bust cycles. ASML's upward revision to its forecast indicates that the cycle may be turning upward.
Why does the share price rise? An upward revision to revenue expectations means higher future earnings and a higher valuation.

tech.title: ASML Says It Can’t Keep Up With AI Demand for Chip Tools
tech.raw_summary: ASML Holding NV warned that soaring artificial intelligence spending meant that it faces a potential supply shortfall with its chip-making machines in the next two years, even as it boosted its own 20

insight.what: ASML警告AI支出飙升导致芯片制造设备供应短缺，无法满足需求。
insight.why: 市场原本假设供应链能跟上AI需求，供应短缺意味着芯片产能扩张受限，算力供给瓶颈可能推高芯片价格。
insight.chain: AI需求↑ → ASML设备供应短缺 → 晶圆厂扩产受限 → 芯片供给↓ → 芯片价格↑ → 算力成本↑ → AI应用成本↑
notes: 为什么供应短缺重要？如果设备不够，晶圆厂无法扩产，芯片供给受限。
芯片价格如何影响？供不应求推高价格，下游AI公司成本上升。
算力成本是什么？AI训练和推理需要大量芯片，芯片贵了算力就贵。
为什么ASML无法扩产？光刻机生产复杂，扩产需要时间和投资。
传导到资产：芯片股受益于价格上涨，AI应用公司承压于成本上升。

insight_en.what: ASML warned that surging AI spending has led to a shortage of chipmaking equipment, with supply unable to meet demand.
insight_en.why: The market had assumed that the supply chain could keep pace with AI demand. Supply shortages mean chip production capacity expansion is constrained, and bottlenecks in the supply of computing power could push up chip prices.
insight_en.chain: AI demand↑ → ASML equipment supply shortages → Wafer fab capacity expansion constrained → Chip supply↓ → Chip prices↑ → Compute costs↑ → AI application costs↑
notes: Why do supply shortages matter? If there is not enough equipment, wafer fabs cannot expand capacity, constraining chip supply.
What is the impact of chip prices? Demand exceeding supply pushes up prices, increasing costs for downstream AI companies.
What are compute costs? AI training and inference require large numbers of chips. When chips become more expensive, compute becomes more expensive.
Why can't ASML expand capacity? Lithography machines are complex to produce, and expanding capacity requires time and investment.
Transmission to assets: Chip stocks benefit from higher prices, while AI application companies come under pressure from rising costs.
